comment: * * This is an extended exception. Java before version 1.4 did not offer the * possibility the attach a cause to an exception. The cause of an exception is * the Throwable object which was thrown and caused the * exception. This interface must be implemented by all exceptions to accomplish * this additional functionality. * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API *

methods.name: Throwable getCause()
methods.comment:
* Returns the cause of the exception.
     * 
     * @return The cause of the exception.
